name: Ancient Tactician
summary: At the start of your Command phase, if this model is on the battlefield, you gain 1CP.

name: Ancient Tactician (Once per turn, per army)
summary: Once per turn, per army: when you target this unit with a Stratagem, that use of the Stratagem costs 1 fewer CP.

name: Anvil of Endurance
summary: In the Fight phase, when a model in this unit is destroyed, if this unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When the unit has fought, or at the end of the phase, whichever comes first, that model is then removed from the battlefield.

name: Battle-lust
summary: If this unit made a charge move this turn, this model's melee attacks have +2 Attacks.

name: Berserk Charge
summary: This unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

name: Bestial Fury
summary: Advance and Charge rolls made for this model can be re-rolled.

name: Bestial Rage
summary: In your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot, if this unit lost a wound as a result of those attacks, this unit can make a surge move of up to D6+1".

name: Blizzard Shield
summary: The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save.

name: Champion of the Kingsguard
summary: This model's attacks that target a CHARACTER unit can re-roll hit rolls of 1 and can re-roll wound rolls of 1.

name: Cunning Hunters
summary: In the Fight phase, if this unit is within range of an objective, this unit's melee attacks have +1 S and +1 AP.

name: Deadly Stalkers
summary: Each attack a model in this unit makes against an enemy unit gains +1 to the Wound roll if no other enemy units are within 6" of the target.

name: Death Totem
summary: When this unit makes melee attacks, it can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

name: EMBARKING WITHIN TRANSPORTS
summary: This model can embark within friendly Adeptus Astartes transports that can carry Terminator models, taking up the space of 4 Infantry models.

name: Fervour of the Ancients
summary: Friendly Space Wolves units within 6" of this unit have +1 to Advance rolls and +1 to Charge rolls.

name: Fervour of the Ancients (Aura)
summary: While a friendly Space Wolves unit is within 6" of this model, add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for it.

name: FORCE OF UNTAMED DESTRUCTION
summary: This model cannot be selected as your Warlord.

name: Gift of the Iron Wolf
summary: In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit's move, select up to one friendly Space Wolves Vehicle model within 3" of this model. That Vehicle model heals D3 wounds, and that Vehicle model's attacks can ignore modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls until the start of your next Movement phase. You cannot select the same Vehicle model for this ability more than once per phase.

name: Guile of the Wolf
summary: At the start of each phase, the assault doctrine, devastator doctrine and tactical doctrine are active for this unit.

name: Guile of the Wolf (Aura)
summary: Once per turn, when your opponent targets one of their own units within 12" of this model with a Stratagem, you can add 1 CP to that Stratagem cost.

name: Hammer Blow
summary: In the Fight phase, when this unit has fought, select up to one enemy MONSTER/VEHICLE unit hit by those attacks. If you do, that enemy unit is suppressed until the start of your next turn. While a unit is suppressed, that unit's attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

name: Headhunters
summary: At the start of the first battle round, select up to one enemy unit to be this unit's quarry. This unit's attacks that target its quarry have [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] and [PRECISION]. Each time this unit's quarry is destroyed, select one enemy unit to be this unit's quarry.

name: Healing Balms
summary: In your Command phase, this unit heals D3+1 wounds.

name: Heroic Last Stand
summary: In the Fight phase, when this model is destroyed, if this unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6. On a 2+, do not remove this model from the battlefield; it is removed from the battlefield when this unit has fought or at the end of the phase, whichever comes first.

name: High King of Fenris (Once per battle round, per unit)
summary: Once per battle round, per unit. In your Movement phase, select up to one friendly Space Wolves unit in strategic reserves. If you do, when that unit makes an ingress move, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

name: High Rune Priest (psyker level 3)
summary: This model has the psychic abilities listed in the Runic Abilities section.

name: Hunting Hounds
summary: While this unit is within 6" of a friendly Space Wolves Character model (excluding Wulfen), and this unit is not battle-shocked, this unit has +1 OC.

name: Judgement of the Omnissiah
summary: This model's attacks can re-roll wound rolls when they target an enemy unit engaged with a friendly Space Wolves Vehicle.

name: Legendary Tenacity
summary: Each attack against this model whose Strength exceeds its Toughness has -1 applied to its Wound roll.

name: Let Loose the Wolves
summary: At the start of the Declare Battle Formations step, you can split this unit into two units: one containing all Wolf Guard Headtaker models plus all leader/support models, and one containing all Hunting Wolves models. Each resulting unit has a new Starting Strength set accordingly.

name: Murder-maker
summary: In the Fight phase, when a friendly Wulfen model within 6" of this unit is destroyed, if that model's unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, that model is not removed from the battlefield; it is removed when your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase, whichever comes first.

name: Murder-maker (Aura)
summary: In the Fight phase, if an attack destroys a model in a friendly Wulfen unit within 6" of this model before it has fought, roll a D6: on a 4+ it is not removed yet, fighting after the attacker finishes before being removed.

name: Murderous Hurricane (psychic level 1)
summary: Psychic level 1. In your Movement phase, if this unit is not battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do: on a 1, this unit is battle-shocked; and select one visible enemy unit within 12" — that enemy unit cannot make Snap shooting attacks.

name: Oathbound
summary: This unit's melee attacks have +1 to hit rolls. Or: this unit's melee attacks that target this unit's slayer's oath have +1 to hit rolls and +1 to wound rolls.

name: Old Greymanes
summary: During the Declare Battle Formations step, you can split this unit into two units, each containing as equal a number of models as possible. When splitting in this way, note which models form each of the two new units.

name: Predatory Instinct
summary: In your opponent's Movement phase, if an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit and this unit is not within Engagement Range, it can make a Normal move of up to D6".

name: Predatory Instinct (Once per battle round, per unit)
summary: Once per battle round, per unit. In the opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit, if this unit is unengaged, this unit can make a normal move of up to D6".

name: Rugged Resilience
summary: Each attack against this unit whose Strength exceeds its Toughness has -1 applied to its Wound roll.

name: Savage Frenzy
summary: Each non-Monster, non-Vehicle enemy unit within Engagement Range of this unit that Falls Back must take a Desperate Escape test, at -1 if it is Battle-shocked.

name: Slayer's Oath
summary: At the start of the first battle round, select up to one enemy CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE unit to be this unit's slayer's oath. This unit's attacks that target its slayer's oath can ignore modifiers to this unit's BS and WS, and modifiers to Hit rolls.

name: Storm Caller (psychic level 1)
summary: When an enemy unit targets this unit, if this unit is not battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do: on a 1, this unit is battle-shocked; and this unit has -3" detection range until the end of the phase.

name: Tempered Ferocity
summary: This unit's attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. This unit's attacks that target an enemy unit within 6" of this unit can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

name: Tempest’s Wrath (Psychic)
summary: After this model's unit shoots, select one hit non-Monster, non-Vehicle enemy unit struck by its Living Lightning weapon: until your next turn, ranged weapons equipped by that unit's models have their Range reduced by 6" (minimum 12").

name: Tempest's Wrath (psychic level 1)
summary: In your Shooting phase, if this unit is not battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do: on a 1, this unit is battle-shocked; and select one visible enemy unit within 18". That enemy unit is suppressed until the start of your next turn. While a unit is suppressed, that unit's attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

name: Thunderous Charge
summary: If this unit made a charge move this turn, this unit's melee attacks have +1 S and +1 D.

name: Violent Fury
summary: If this model is equipped with two melee weapons, those weapon profiles have the Twin-linked ability.

name: War Howl
summary: While this model is attached to a Blood Claws unit, that unit's melee attacks have +1 S and [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. While this model is attached to a Wolf Guard Headtakers unit, when that unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent the unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

name: Wind Walker
summary: This unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT]. When this unit is selected to make an Advance move, it can change its Advance roll to a 6.

name: Wind Walker (Psychic)
summary: While this model leads a unit, ranged weapons equipped by models in it have the Assault ability, and each time the unit Advances it skips the Advance roll and instead adds 6" to its Move characteristic until the end of the phase.
